g.text: Falling snow is common but usually patchy. Snow on the ground is rare: widespread
lying snow happened four times, exactly matching the Met Office's own record.
Data: Met Office MIDAS Open, UK daily weather observations (v202607), via CEDA. Open Government Licence.
Station sets differ by panel, as in the Met Office's published figures: top = stations observed all day;
bottom = stations with a valid 09:00 depth reading. 1973's single snow report is flagged suspect and excluded.
